description: OpenID Foundation conformance suite release-v5.3.3, oidcc-client-basic-certification-test-plan (static client, client_secret_basic). Swiss reports rather than refuses, so a negative test passes when Swiss shows the finding named in `swiss` and the harness, seeing it, makes no UserInfo call.

oidcc-client-test.reason: A sound sign-in: Swiss verifies the ID token and reports nothing, so the harness makes the UserInfo call that finishes the test.

oidcc-client-test-invalid-iss.reason: Swiss reports the wrong issuer next to the token instead of refusing it; seeing the finding, the harness makes no UserInfo call, which the suite requires.

oidcc-client-test-missing-sub.reason: Swiss reports the missing sub (required by OpenID Connect Core 2), and the harness stops there.

oidcc-client-test-invalid-aud.reason: Swiss reports an audience that is not its client ID, and the harness stops there.

oidcc-client-test-missing-iat.reason: Swiss reports the missing iat, and the harness stops there.

oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-single-jwks.reason: No kid, one key: Swiss verifies with the only key and reports nothing.

oidcc-client-test-kid-absent-multiple-jw.reason: No kid, several keys: Swiss tries each matching key until one verifies. Found by this harness: before 3.2 it stopped at "multiple matching keys found".

oidcc-client-test-idtoken-sig-none.reason: Swiss reports the unsigned ID token, so the harness makes no UserInfo call; the suite marks this optional test SKIPPED when a client declines alg none.

oidcc-client-test-invalid-sig-rs256.reason: Swiss reports the bad signature, and the harness stops there.

oidcc-client-test-userinfo-invalid-sub.reason: The suite passes once UserInfo is called. Comparing the UserInfo sub with the ID token is the calling app's job; Swiss has no UserInfo client, so this test says nothing about Swiss.

oidcc-client-test-nonce-invalid.swiss: `nonce` in the ID token does not match
oidcc-client-test-nonce-invalid.reason: Swiss reports the mismatched nonce, and the harness stops there.

oidcc-client-test-scope-userinfo-claims.reason: Swiss requests openid profile email; the suite passes once UserInfo is called with that token.

oidcc-client-test-client-secret-basic.reason: The token request authenticates with client_secret_basic (the environment's client authentication is HTTP Basic).
